raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Single-node multimodal requests using `--skip-tokenizer-init` bypass shared-memory feature transport. Both `wrap_shm_features()` and `unwrap_shm_features()` return early based on tokenizer initialization, even though local SHM availability depends on node topology. This causes CPU features and precomputed embeddings to be serialized inline for token-ID-only requests, increasing IPC payloads and host-memory pressure during repeated multimodal requests.

## Modifications

- Remove the `skip_tokenizer_init` condition from both SHM helpers and remove the unused serving-config import.
- Preserve `_get_is_default_transport()`, including its `nnodes > 1` protection.
- Add a registered CPU regression test covering exact Tensor round trips, precomputed hashes, batched requests, SHM cleanup, and both tokenizer settings on single-node and multi-node layouts.
- Remove obsolete serving-config mocks from existing SHM ownership and error-consensus tests.

## Accuracy Tests

The new regression test fails on the unmodified upstream code for both single and batched requests with `skip_tokenizer_init=True`. It passes after the fix.

The following tests passed against the modified upstream checkout: **13 tests and 13 subtests**. The round-trip tests assert exact Tensor values; the existing suite also exercises two-process SHM ownership and failure consensus.

```bash
python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider \
  test/registered/unit/multimodal/test_shm_feature_transport.py \
  test/registered/unit/multimodal/test_tensor_transport_mode.py \
  test/registered/unit/managers/test_mm_shm_error_consensus.py
```

## Speed Tests and Profiling

No end-to-end serving benchmark was run. This change enables the existing SHM path for CPU multimodal tensors when tokenizer initialization is skipped.

## Checklist

- [x] Run pre-commit on all changed files, including formatting and registered-test validation.
- [x] Add registered CPU unit tests and verify that they reproduce the original issue.
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style guidance.
- [x] Review documentation requirements: no new flags or APIs are introduced.

+"""Regression tests for SHM transport with token-ID-only multimodal requests."""
+
+import pickle
+import unittest
+from array import array
+from multiprocessing import shared_memory
+from unittest.mock import patch
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import maybe_stub_sgl_kernel
+
+maybe_stub_sgl_kernel()
+
+from sglang.srt.managers import mm_utils  # noqa: E402
+from sglang.srt.managers.io_struct import (  # noqa: E402
+    BatchTokenizedEmbeddingReqInput,
+    TokenizedEmbeddingReqInput,
+)
+from sglang.srt.managers.schedule_batch import (  # noqa: E402
+    Modality,
+    MultimodalDataItem,
+    MultimodalProcessorOutput,
+)
+from sglang.srt.runtime_context import get_context  # noqa: E402
+from sglang.srt.sampling.sampling_params import SamplingParams  # noqa: E402
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=11, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+
+def _request(feature, precomputed_embeddings):
+    return TokenizedEmbeddingReqInput(
+        rid="shm-feature-request",
+        input_text=None,
+        input_ids=array("q", [1]),
+        mm_inputs=MultimodalProcessorOutput(
+            mm_items=[
+                MultimodalDataItem(
+                    modality=Modality.IMAGE,
+                    hash=37,
+                    feature=feature,
+                    precomputed_embeddings=precomputed_embeddings,
+                )
+            ]
+        ),
+        token_type_ids=None,
+        sampling_params=SamplingParams(),
+    )
+
+
+class TestShmFeatureTransport(unittest.TestCase):
+    def test_single_node_round_trip_with_or_without_tokenizer(self):
+        for skip_tokenizer_init in (False, True):
+            for batched in (False, True):
+                with (
+                    self.subTest(
+                        skip_tokenizer_init=skip_tokenizer_init, batched=batched
+                    ),
+                    get_context().override_server_args(
+                        nnodes=1, skip_tokenizer_init=skip_tokenizer_init
+                    ),
+                    patch.object(mm_utils, "_is_default_tensor_transport", None),
+                ):
+                    tensors = {
+                        "feature": torch.arange(12, dtype=torch.float32)
+                        .reshape(3, 4)
+                        .T,
+                        "precomputed_embeddings": torch.arange(
+                            8, dtype=torch.float32
+                        ).reshape(2, 4),
+                    }
+                    sender = _request(**tensors)
+                    receiver = None
+                    shm_names = []
+                    try:
+                        mm_utils.wrap_shm_features(sender)
+                        item = sender.mm_inputs.mm_items[0]
+                        for field in tensors:
+                            pointer = getattr(item, field)
+                            self.assertIsInstance(pointer, mm_utils.ShmPointerMMData)
+                            self.assertEqual(pointer.precomputed_hash, 37)
+                            shm_names.append(pointer.shm_name)
+
+                        receiver = pickle.loads(pickle.dumps(sender))
+                        request = receiver
+                        if batched:
+                            receiver = BatchTokenizedEmbeddingReqInput(batch=[request])
+                        mm_utils.unwrap_shm_features(receiver)
+                        for field, expected in tensors.items():
+                            actual = getattr(request.mm_inputs.mm_items[0], field)
+                            self.assertIsInstance(actual, torch.Tensor)
+                            torch.testing.assert_close(actual, expected, rtol=0, atol=0)
+
+                        for name in shm_names:
+                            try:
+                                handle = shared_memory.SharedMemory(name=name)
+                            except FileNotFoundError:
+                                continue
+                            handle.close()
+                            self.fail(f"SHM segment {name} was not unlinked")
+                    finally:
+                        mm_utils.discard_shm_features(sender)
+                        if receiver is not None:
+                            mm_utils.discard_shm_features(receiver)
+
+    def test_multi_node_keeps_inline_features_with_or_without_tokenizer(self):
+        for skip_tokenizer_init in (False, True):
+            with (
+                self.subTest(skip_tokenizer_init=skip_tokenizer_init),
+                get_context().override_server_args(
+                    nnodes=2, skip_tokenizer_init=skip_tokenizer_init
+                ),
+                patch.object(mm_utils, "_is_default_tensor_transport", None),
+            ):
+                feature = torch.ones(2, 3)
+                embeddings = torch.ones(3, 4)
+                request = _request(feature, embeddings)
+                self.assertIs(mm_utils.wrap_shm_features(request), request)
+                self.assertIs(mm_utils.unwrap_shm_features(request), request)
+                item = request.mm_inputs.mm_items[0]
+                self.assertIs(item.feature, feature)
+                self.assertIs(item.precomputed_embeddings, embeddings)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
